signature.task_pattern: Judges penalize candidates for mentioning non-visual semantic labels (e.g., 'website') even when the label is contextually plausible and the visual elements are correctly described.
signature.visual_focus: The visual grounding criterion prioritizes accurate description of observable elements (color, text, layout) over semantic interpretation of the text's function or origin.
signature.candidate_difference: Candidate A correctly describes the visual elements (white background, black text, contrast) but incorrectly labels the text as 'logo' text, which is not visually verifiable. Candidate B correctly describes the visual elements and accurately labels the text as 'website' text, which is contextually appropriate and visually grounded.
signature.parent_failure: The parent criterion failed to recognize that Candidate B’s mention of 'website' text is not a visual element but a semantic label that is contextually appropriate and does not violate visual grounding. The parent incorrectly assumed that labeling text as 'website' text is a visual misstep, when it is actually a correct contextual interpretation that aligns with the image’s purpose.
